The '''Passive Defender PD-0943''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] dispersion system manufactured by [[Zemphyr Defenders, Incorporated]]. A hand-held spray, the Passive Defender PD-0943 released a gas that was a mixture of [[courenth]] and [[ves]] that dispersed blaster bolts on contact.
